contrasts.identifies: Conditional implementation effect of deleting exhausted-key dictionary entries with original list buckets and unchanged search/height traces
contrasts.does_not_identify: Full immediate object reclamation, link detachment or duplicate grouping

contrasts.identifies: Same map-entry cleanup effect conditional on linked occurrence buckets
contrasts.does_not_identify: A universal cleanup effect independent of bucket implementation or garbage collection

contrasts.identifies: Net effect of occurrence-preserving direct removal, including added hashing, handles and allocation, conditional on retained history
contrasts.does_not_identify: Pure asymptotic removal savings with all other machine costs erased

contrasts.identifies: Same bucket-policy effect conditional on exhausted-key map cleanup
contrasts.does_not_identify: Duplicate compression; both arms retain one skiplist node per occurrence

contrasts.definition: (linked_map/list_map) / (linked_retain/list_retain), formed within a paired block before source aggregation
contrasts.identifies: Multiplicative interaction of these two concrete implementation changes on the measured workload
contrasts.does_not_identify: Independent main effects when the interaction is non-negligible

contrasts.identifies: Net difference between the existing grouped compact policy and a cleaned occurrence-preserving direct-bucket policy
contrasts.does_not_identify: Isolated duplicate grouping: live representative policy, node/height consumption, per-value metadata and link detachment also differ

frozen_protocol.status: Frozen proposed design; correctness preflight passed; performance and memory experiments NOT executed
frozen_protocol.preregistration: Private computational plan after examining phase-two results; not public preregistration or an independent confirmatory sample
frozen_protocol.scope: Marginal bookkeeping costs at fixed occurrence-level skiplist semantics; grouped policy is an explicitly coupled secondary comparison

selection_rationale.grid_8100: High duplicate pressure and large prior combined-repair gain
selection_rationale.geometric_8192: Mostly distinct numeric keys; prior repair showed little query-time gain
selection_rationale.ny: Large real integer graph and large historical-retention footprint
selection_rationale.sparse_2048__lopsided: Frozen-advisor saturation/collision stress, not a realism claim

common_components: Frozen phase-two bitmap rank index and original skiplist methods
Original valRank per-occurrence lists in all four occurrence arms
Same scalar-distance to LIFO-vertex routing kernel
Same frozen linear advisor fitted from one common training-source heap trace
Same queue seed across methods within each block; seeds reset outside timers

cleanup.map: Delete sl.nodes[value] only after valRank[value] disappears, meaning the last live occurrence was extracted; retain node links

rank_bucket.linked: Doubly linked occurrence sequence plus value-to-deque handles; append order, tail hint and first-equal removal preserved

not_changed: No changes to sampling or comparison decisions

frozen_protocol.validity_contract: Finite numeric keys and fixed deterministic monotone rank prediction; the original arbitrary-advice duplicate defects are not claimed repaired

preflight.purpose: Correctness/semantic preflight only; no performance measurements
preflight.validity_contract: Finite numeric priorities, frozen deterministic monotone ranks; original arbitrary-advice duplicate failures are not claimed repaired.

coupling_evidence.finding: An extracted newest duplicate may remain the value-to-node hint representative while an older equal key remains live. Clearing its links invalidates subsequent insertion. Original and map-only controls pass this trace.
coupling_evidence.interpretation: This is failure of our attempted transformation, not failure of the original queue on this trace

timing.processes: Fresh process per paired block; shuffled block and method order
timing.warmup: One validated warmup per method; warm RNG and class loading before measurement
timing.gc: Disable cyclic GC during query as in phase two; force collection before methods and record cleanup separately
timing.include: Queue construction, predictor lookup, shared routing and queue work
timing.exclude: Graph loading, oracle checks, training/build, diagnostic tracing and forced post-query collection
timing.outliers: No time-based filtering; preserve all failures and stop attribution if semantic parity fails

memory.source_subset: First training source and first far query for each of the four targets
memory.processes: Fresh process per target/method/GC mode; prewarm NumPy RNG and AST runtime before tracing
phases: empty queue alive before full collection
empty queue alive after full collection
memory.scope: Python traced allocations, graph/oracle excluded; record RSS high-water separately; never call a query-only peak whole-pipeline peak

bounded_live_diagnostic.keys: unique increasing values; isolates exhausted-key history from duplicate grouping

analysis.unit: Per-source median paired repetition ratios; six source units per target grouped by three training sources
analysis.intervals: Exploratory training-cluster bootstrap only; too few clusters for broad confirmatory inference
analysis.report: Every contrast, both clocks, each target separately; no universal winner or full factor attribution to grouping
analysis.stop_rule: Any output, hint, operand, live-node or height mismatch invalidates the corresponding clean ablation; preserve and investigate before performance claims

frozen_protocol.performance_runner: Not implemented or executed in this preparation task; runner must enforce this frozen plan before data collection

execution_manifest.status: Frozen execution manifest; measurements not started

full_trace_gate.coverage: 24 source cases, first planned seed per case, four occurrence variants; not every timing seed

execution_manifest.analysis_boundary: Postprocessing analysis is not imported by workers and is excluded from executed-source hash guards; its final version is separately recorded in the analysis summary. Gate/preflight evidence is pinned as an execution prerequisite.
execution_refinements: One separate process per job; all timing precedes memory stages.
Memory modes/seed fixed here where proposal specified policies; graph memory uses repeat-zero case seed, retention seed101.
Memory training uses the unchanged collector/Advisor but avoids allocating large validation digest strings while tracing.
Automatic collection stays disabled after query/drain until the pre-GC snapshot and explicit collection.
Timing failure invalidates the paired block; preserve partial records and stop the sequence for review.

coverage.full_trace_gate_scope: All 24 source cases, four occurrence variants, repeat-zero seed only; not every timed seed or a universal equivalence proof.

environment.host_control: Shared host; CPU affinity, frequency, thermal state and OS activity uncontrolled.

training.cost_scope: One common phase-two native_heap trace plus phase-two linear Advisor build; validation outside clocks.

index.memory_scope: reachable Python objects owned/referenced by index; shared objects counted once; not RSS
index.complexity: O(log_64 U) predecessor/add/remove; NOT a van Emde Boas implementation

memory_runs.memory_scope: Graph/oracle and prewarmed libraries excluded. Query peak includes advisor, metadata, distances, routing and queue. Empty-queue snapshots drop distances/routing but retain advisor, with automatic GC disabled until explicit collection. After-destruction snapshots retain small training/statistics reports. RSS is lifetime high-water, not exact component memory. Training peak omits large validation digest-string construction.

memory_interpretation: Each graph/model/method/GC-mode memory case is measured in a separate process; there is only one fixed held-out source per target, so no source-level interval is inferred.
Training/build and query-phase peaks have different boundaries. Fitted-run peak is their maximum, not their sum; query peak alone is not cold fitted-run peak.
The retained advisor remains part of traced graph-query measurements unless a field explicitly records its destruction. Baseline subtraction is not asserted to isolate queue storage exactly.
Full post-query allocations include distance/routing outputs. Empty-queue retention before and after collection must be read with the runner's explicit object-lifetime boundaries.

A map entry can disappear while a node remains reachable through other references or unreachable cycles await collection. Compare before/after GC and enabled/disabled modes rather than interpreting map cardinality as total object memory.
RSS fields are process lifetime high-water values; their differences are not component sizes. Graph/oracle and native allocations are not fully measured by tracemalloc.
Bounded-live traces use unique priorities and constant advice; grouping is inactive, but other compact-policy differences remain. These memory-only runs are not timing evidence.

Compared with phase two, these workers fully prewarm RNG and omit a large training-validation digest-string allocation. Absolute residual/training peaks across phases must not be attributed solely to adapter changes; the within-phase-three arms share these refined boundaries.

gc_mode_diagnostics.scope: Descriptive paired cases from separate memory processes; not timing evidence or a confidence interval. A before/after full-GC allocation decrease need not mean cycle reclamation, because collection can also change interpreter free lists.

interpretation: All timing ratios, including interaction, are calculated within a paired block, then collapsed by held-out query/training source before target-level summarization.
Ratios below one favor the numerator method. Interaction is (linked_map/list_map)/(linked_retain/list_retain), not a ratio of separately aggregated effects.
The two-by-two contrasts identify conditional implementation effects in the frozen occurrence-preserving adapters. They do not erase added hashing, allocation, or container costs.
The grouped bridge is a coupled policy comparison, not an isolated causal effect of duplicate grouping.
Failures and coverage/hash discrepancies must be read with successful-pair summaries. Missing/failing pairs are never silently substituted or rerun by this analysis.
The attribution gate combines frozen semantic preflight, worker correctness and complete hash/spec coverage; it is not a proof of semantic equivalence on every possible input.
Graph instances were selected after phase-two findings and reused. This is a post-hoc mechanism study, not an independent confirmatory graph sample.
Three training clusters, one shared host, disabled query GC and few source cases limit interpretation. Scheduling thresholds are descriptive only.
Forced cleanup includes dropping the complete result (distances, routing and queue) followed by full gc.collect; it is not isolated node-reclamation time or a deployment garbage-collection schedule.
